maria_procure: FYI — Nexa emailed: allocation for our Nov H100 wave just dropped from 24 -> 12 units. Lead time pushed +3 weeks. They also flagged a separate EU RMA container that hit customs; could be ~1wk hold. repeating the email below.
chris_ops: ugh. do we know which customer commitments this impacts?
jordan_infra: short answer: 3 Dedicated pools will hit sustained capacity shortfall if we don't top up from another lane. Can we borrow from the FRA temp pool?
maria_procure: timeline: original ETA 2026-11-04, new ETA 2026-11-25. Nexa says partial air option but +$1.6k/unit. They quoted AWB `NEX-GBR-88221` for the delayed batch.
emily_logistics: EU RMA hold — customs requested serial manifest + repair authorizations. Nexa said they submitted docs yesterday but customs flagged HS code mismatch. We should escalate local broker.
chris_ops: cost question: is +$1.6k/unit cheaper than customer SLA credits if we miss the Dedicated commits? need quick calc.
jordan_infra: rough math: SLA credits + lost revenue + ops churn ~ $2.1k/unit over the cycle. So air uplift seems preferable for critical pools. But that's for H100s — for H200s different.
maria_procure: requesting approval to accept partial air for 8 units to cover critical pools (prod/ingest/qa). Keep 4 sea units for lower-priority jobs. 
emily_logistics: I'll open an expedite ticket with FRA broker and ask Nexa for proof of payment for customs docs. Also: RMA container (EU batch) — we've opened a depot hold flow (ticket #T-4982).
chris_ops: if we take partial air, we need to update routing policies so traffic falls back to older quantized models gracefully. Jordan can you add a temp route that pins to smaller batch nodes?
jordan_infra: yep — can add a route policy `fallback:quantized-v1` for the three affected pool ids. Will push canary at 12:30.
maria_procure: approving partial air for 8 units. Please capture vendor PO amendment and delta invoicing. Emily — confirm vendor acceptance and attach updated AWB and invoice.
emily_logistics: will do. pinging Nexa procurement: "Can you confirm 8 air units at +$1.6k/unit and provide amended PO & AWB?" (forwarded).
ops-bot: Reminder: Procurement approval recorded by maria_procure at 1749512480.
chris_ops: ok next: RMA routing — if customs doesn't release the container in 72h we want to swap routing to depot in NL for faster clearance. Emily can you prep fallback docs?
emily_logistics: will prep NL depot manifest and arrange courier hold. Need serial list + warranty slips from Nexa. Maria — can you push for those now?
maria_procure: already asked. Nexa replied: "serial list attached, warranty slips pending signature due today." I'll push for e-sign.
jordan_infra: ops caveat: if we re-route to NL depot we may see 24-48h added transit. Still better than open customs hold for unknown time.
chris_ops: sounds good. everyone add a line to the provisioning runbook under "vendor-exception -> nexasupply" with the new fallback. I'll start the PR.
emily_logistics: incoming: Nexa confirmed amended PO and AWB for 8 air units at +$1.6k/unit, AWB `NEX-GBR-88221-A`. attaching docs to ticket T-4981.
maria_procure: thanks. Emily — once docs are attached, tag finance to process uplift. cc @finance.
chris_ops: quick note for SRE: monitor queue depth on pool-prod-3 and set alert threshold to 80% capacity until full shipment reconciled.
jordan_infra: will do — creating alert and temp autoscale cap.
maria_procure: closing loop: final ask — Emily, update the RMA playbook with steps: broker escalation, PO amendment, NL re-route, invoice uplift. Put PR in docs repo and ping thread.
emily_logistics: on it. PR incoming in ~30m. :thumbsup:
maria_procure: thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for followups.
